parameters.query: SELECT po.po_number, po.vendor_name, po.vendor_tax_id, po.subtotal, po.tax_amount, po.total_amount, po.currency, po.status, (SELECT status FROM erp.invoices WHERE invoice_number = $2 LIMIT 1) AS existing_invoice_status, COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('sku', items.sku, 'description', items.description, 'quantity', items.quantity, 'unit_price', items.unit_price, 'total_price', items.total_price)) FILTER (WHERE items.id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::json) AS po_items FROM erp.purchase_orders po LEFT JOIN erp.purchase_order_items items ON po.po_number = items.po_number WHERE po.po_number = $1 GROUP BY po.po_number;

INSERT INTO erp.invoices (invoice_number, po_number, vendor_name, vendor_tax_id, invoice_date, subtotal, tax_amount, total_amount, variance_pct, status, decision_by, decision_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, 'AUTO_APPROVED', 'SYSTEM_3WAY_RULE', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (invoice_number) DO UPDATE SET status = 'AUTO_APPROVED', decision_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;

parameters.responseBody:
={
  "status": "SUCCESS",
  "invoice_number": "{{ $json.invoice_number }}",
  "decision": "AUTO_APPROVED",
  "variance_pct": {{ $json.variance_pct }},
  "payment_dispatched": true,
  "message": "Invoice matched PO within 0.5% tolerance and under $2,000 threshold. Payment queued."
}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO erp.invoices (invoice_number, po_number, vendor_name, vendor_tax_id, invoice_date, subtotal, tax_amount, total_amount, variance_pct, status, approval_token) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, 'PENDING_APPROVAL', $10) ON CONFLICT (invoice_number) DO UPDATE SET status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL', approval_token = $10; INSERT INTO erp.pending_approvals (invoice_number, token, variance_pct, requires_executive_signoff, status, expires_at) VALUES ($1, $10, $9, ($8 >= 2000), 'PENDING', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '48 hours');
UPDATE erp.invoices SET status = $1, decision_by = $2, decision_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE invoice_number = $3; UPDATE erp.pending_approvals SET status = $1 WHERE invoice_number = $3;

parameters.responseBody:
={
  "status": "SUCCESS",
  "invoice_number": "{{ $json.invoice_number }}",
  "updated_status": "{{ $json.status }}",
  "decision_by": "{{ $json.decision_by }}",
  "message": "Approval callback processed and ERP records synchronized."
}
